description: A navigation column where a dashed line runs down from the top and snaps into the active row with a cornered hook; the row under the indicator gets its own faint hook.
interactionNotes: Click any row to select it; the colored line runs from the top of the list to the center of that row and joins it with a 6px corner. On hover (or Tab focus) a faint dashed line is drawn from the active row to the row under the pointer, so you can see where a click will take you. The line moves on a spring, not in jumps. If you pass `href` the row becomes a link, otherwise a button; either way `onChange` fires.

props.items: The rows. Each item is either a string or `{ label, href }`; items with `href` render as links, the rest as buttons.
props.label: Heading above the column. It also becomes the navigation `aria-label` unless you provide your own `aria-label`.
props.value: Selected index in controlled mode. This is the one to use for syncing with the route (e.g. with `usePathname`).
props.onChange: Returns the new index on every selection.
props.color: Color of the active line. Any CSS value works; if your project has no `--brand`, it falls back to the text color.
props.dashed: Dashed line (default) or a solid line.
props.className: Outer class on the `nav`; set the column width here.

tips: The component does not set the column width itself; pass `className="w-52"` or any other width so the rows share the same width.
`next/link` is deliberately not imported — the shipped version must compile in non-Next projects too. If you want soft navigation, feed `value` from the route.
The line position is measured from the DOM, so long text or a different font size won't break it; a `ResizeObserver` watches both the rows and the whole list.
In RTL the column comes in from the right and the hook turns to the left; don't mirror anything by hand.
For long lists a fixed height with `overflow-y-auto` is better than an endless column; the line is measured inside that frame.
